Without flatness, the faces may be warped within the parallelism zone and fail to seat properly; the designer should add a flatness tolerance to the primary shim faces.","recommended_correction":"Add a flatness GD&T callout to the main shim faces appropriate for the mating requirement."},{"rule_id":"TL-016","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: M.S # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. This leaves the finish requirement ambiguous for any surface not explicitly marked, risking inconsistent manufacturing quality; the designer should add a general surface roughness symbol in parentheses around the title block or specify it in the notes.","recommended_correction":"Add a general surface roughness symbol (e.g., Ra 6.3 in parentheses) to cover all unspecified machined surfaces."}]}
